source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: You have mastered the art of appearing harmless. When caught in a compromising situation, you may make a Deception check as a reaction before consequences are applied. On a success the observer assumes your involvement was unintentional or coincidental. Additionally, authority figures who are not actively searching for you make Perception checks to notice suspicious behavior on your part at disadvantage, having already dismissed you as a non-threat..
